title: Set up Email Ops
description: Create your inbox command post, connect Gmail, and link the mailbox. Ori reads and drafts; it never sends without you.

steps.title: Review your Email Ops team
steps.description: Meet the Postmaster and the Inbox specialist, adjust what you like, and create the workspace. Nothing is created until you confirm in the creator.

steps.title: Connect Gmail
steps.description: Connect your Google account and enable Gmail in Settings. This happens once and is shared by every workspace you allow. Come back here and choose Check again.

steps.title: Link the mailbox
steps.description: Link the connected account to this workspace. Email Ops will read and search this mailbox and prepare drafts. It never sends a message without your confirmation of that specific message.

steps.title: Email Ops is ready
steps.description: Your mailbox is linked and Ori can read it. Triaging the inbox is a separate task that needs an AI model; mailbox readiness does not.
